related.title: 白鶴灘水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「大體積混凝土溫控」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Mass-concrete temperature control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦192 m 碾壓混凝土重力壩的快速施工與層面品質；白鶴灘水電站則以百萬瓩級機組、289 m 雙曲拱壩與低熱水泥全壩應用為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rapid construction and lift-joint quality of a 192 m roller-compacted concrete gravity dam; Baihetan Hydropower Station centres on million-kilowatt units, a 289 m double-curvature arch dam and low-heat cement throughout, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「地下廠房洞室與岩體應力」的模型移到白鶴灘水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Underground powerhouse caverns and rock stress" to Baihetan Hydropower Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「大體積混凝土溫控」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；白鶴灘水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Mass-concrete temperature control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Baihetan Hydropower Station must be respecified.

related.title: 衣索比亞復興大壩

related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Mass-concrete temperature control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦192 m 碾壓混凝土重力壩的快速施工與層面品質；衣索比亞復興大壩則以千萬方級碾壓混凝土壩、五公里鞍部壩與跨國水庫初次蓄水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rapid construction and lift-joint quality of a 192 m roller-compacted concrete gravity dam; Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam centres on A ten-million-cubic-metre RCC dam, a five-kilometre saddle dam and first filling of a transboundary reservoir, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

以「大體積混凝土溫控」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 龍灘水電站
history.text: 2001 年主體工程開工；2003 年紅水河截流；2004 年大壩碾壓混凝土開始澆築；2007 年首台機組投產；2009 年一期 7 台機組全部投產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2001: Main works began. 2003: The Hongshui River was closed. 2004: RCC placement in the dam began. 2007: The first unit entered service. 2009: All seven first-stage units were in service. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
